85626.synopsis:
After a long period of unrequited love, I ended up as a duchess in name only.

But for some reason, the once indifferent Ains started clinging to me.
“You don’t need to worry about the illness. It’s already been treated.”

87162.synopsis:

After coming back from the brink of death, everything looked different. I no longer felt the need to please the palace or the compulsion to win Cedric’s love.

But unfortunately, I had a premature birth, and both the baby and I died on the operating table.
In my final moments, Xie Bo Yan, with bloodshot eyes, held my hand tightly.

One day, she was falsely accused of killing the pet dog of the village chief’s granddaughter with poison, and after being whipped, was banished from the village.
Kuno was abandoned in a place known as the [Forest of Death] , where she met a wolf with silver fur. The wolf led her to place where there laid a badly injured, handsome young man lying on the ground…?
“After all, I can’t even make a decent potion.”

92026.synopsis:
After the heiress Mu Wan suddenly died from overworking, she thought it through and came to terms with her situation—let’s fully enjoy her second chance at life by indulging in food, drink, and leisure. To hell with work, scheming, and power struggles!
Then, because of her new carefree attitude, excessive indulgence, and idleness, her engagement was broken off.
Mu Wan: …
Then, out of the blue, an imperial edict came, arranging her marriage to the powerful but intimidating Marquis of Zhenbei—clearly intended as an insult to him.
Mu Wan: ???
Her reborn half-sister arrived, gloating: “So what if he’s tall, elegant, and handsome? Marquis Zhenbei is cold towards women, ruthless, and bloodthirsty. He killed the Empress Dowager and the puppet emperor to put his nephew’s on the throne, but he died on the battlefield later. Even if you don’t die, you’ll soon be widowed, my dear eldest sister.”
What Mu Wan heard amidst the unintelligent noises: Marquis of Zhenbei, put his nephew on the throne, and then died…
So, in a few years, she would inherit both an emperor nephew and all the Marquis’ wealth?
What a stroke of luck! She’s in!
***
Zhenbei Marquis Manor indeed needed a figurehead mistress, so Xie Heng made a strategical decision to marry the easily controlled daughter of a lowly merchant family. It was nothing more than a political move; he treated her as a convenient pet, like a house cat.
But to his surprise, this delicate little cat wasn’t one to be bullied. He couldn’t hit her, nor could he outsmart her in arguments.
Xie Heng began to suspect that she was out to annoy him to death.
One day, Mu Wan sighed: “The Chi Ling Tribe may be barbaric, but their gemstones are truly beautiful.”
Xie Heng, with a cold voice: “So you really wish for my death, don’t you?”
Mu Wan: ???
Later, Xie Heng led his troops to conquer the Chi Ling tribe and threw their royal family’s treasures at Mu Wan, sneering: “Sorry to disappoint you, but this Marquis will live a long life.”
Mu Wan: ???
That same day, Xie Heng lay in bed, flushed and gritting his teeth: “This Marquis will die at your hands sooner or later!”
Mu Wan: …
It was just a simple wound stitching. There’s no need to make it sound so suggestive—her medical skills are great, okay?
Everyone said Marquis Zhenbei Xie Heng was ruthless and cold, and the people he despised the most were those cowards who indulged in pleasures. Yet, when death loomed over him, his first thought was: If he died, who would bring home the tribute fruits for that house cat? Would she be bullied? Who would take good care of her?
He realized then that he must survive, so he could protect her, ensuring she would live a long life, filled with prosperity.
[Cold-hearted, aloof cat-like beauty female lead vs. Crazed, ruthless but secretly tsundere male lead who only softens for her]

100986.synopsis:
I found myself transmigrated into an R-19 romance fantasy novel, where the male lead’s overwhelming charm stood out.

Ten years later, I reunited with Rian.
The beautiful boy I once knew had grown into a man far more handsome than I had ever imagined.

106874.synopsis:
[Was it you, the woman who killed my sister?] 
When I regained memories of my past life, I found myself as the main character in a tragic novel. A woman who killed her husband’s mistress—only to be brutally mu*dered by the mistress’s younger brother.
I only saved that woman to avoid him.
“You are my sister’s savior? Then please, stay as long as you need. Until you find a place to live after your divorce, consider this mansion your home.”
I ended up entangled with the very man who was meant to kill me—with a sword pressed against my throat.
If marriage was a grave, then I had to walk out of it, even in death.
“So, a child from a vulgar, low-class upstart family has joined this prestigious family of scholars.”
“If you can’t even understand that a man sleeping with other women a few times is normal, what are you going to do?”
“Sister, he says he loves me. Could you give him to me?”
From my mother-in-law’s cruelty, my husband’s betrayal, to my younger sister’s deceit—divorce was my only choice.
After the divorce, I planned to leave as promised.
But when did things start to change?
“Tell me the truth. Stop hiding behind that smile, like you always do.”
“……”
“Are you going to cry alone again?”
The man who had always been as cold as the northern wind… had begun to look at me with warmth, like a gentle breeze.

107642.synopsis:
General Qi Ren, long known as the “Mad Wolf,” was carelessly poisoned by an enemy spy on the battlefield and left with a damaged mind. Thus fell a generation’s undefeated war god, leaving many to sigh in regret.  
Having eliminated this highly meritorious subordinate who had become a threat to the throne, the emperor felt a twinge of pity. Hearing street rumors that the madman’s beloved was none other than the court’s timid, mute Seventh Prince, he casually bestowed a marriage upon the two of them, congratulating himself on doing them a good turn.  
After the wedding, however, Fu Yu’an—who now had to play both father and mother, watched the clear-eyed madman climb into his bed and promptly kicked him onto the floor.  
“You’re not a fool?”  
“And you’re not mute either, are you? All crows under heaven are equally black—looking down on me?”  
“……”

108922.synopsis:
[Campus Lit + Lighthearted Daily Life]  
“You failed your math, physics, and chemistry exams—how are you going to get into college? Look at Xiao Lu next door; he’s been smart since he was a kid. Even though his scores in those subjects aren’t great either, he still got into Peking University because of that ‘North Training Cup’ recommendation program. Why don’t you try for something like that?”  
“Mom, Gu Lu is a famous author! He wrote all these bestsellers like Flatland, The Miracles of the Namiya General Store, and The Human Chair. I’m just an ordinary rich kid with decent looks—how can I compare to him?!”

110714.synopsis:
The only one who ever reached out to him had died—
Even though Jiho had used up all his guiding energy for him.
‘If I’d stayed by his side from the start, maybe things would’ve turned out differently…’
Drowning in regret and self-loathing, Jiho collapsed.
When he finally came to, he found himself standing in the middle of the hallway of the illegal guiding facility where he had been confined until three years ago.
“Wh-what’s wrong? Are you hurt?”
And at the end of the hallway—he was there.
Baek Dojin, wearing the same tight-fitting combat uniform as he had that day three years ago.
‘Baek Dojin died. I must be dreaming.’
Maybe this was the last time he would ever see Baek Dojin in a dream.
So Jiho clung to him desperately.
The warmth of the hand patting his shoulder was so comforting that Jiho wished he’d never wake up from the dream.
“Mm… huh…?”
But something felt off.
“I won’t do anything you don’t like. So don’t be afraid.”
Why… why wasn’t he waking up from the dream?

113786.synopsis:
I reincarnated into my all-time favorite romance fantasy novel that I had reread countless times—including all the side stories.
Unfortunately, after getting engaged to the crown prince, I became the pitiful villainess noblewoman who meets a miserable end.
To survive, I decided to twist the original story.
First, I had to stop my duke father from going to ask for my engagement to the crown prince.
“I’ve fallen in love with the Northern Duke!”
But then…
“A marriage contract with the Northern Duke has arrived, my dear Liri!”
Just a few days later, my crazy father returned not with a crown prince engagement—but with a contract tying me to the Northern Duke.
And he even brought the real-life version of the Northern Duke with him.
Come on, Father…
***
The bigger problem is…
The original male lead, the Northern Duke, has started seducing me earnestly.
“Do you know how much your eyes stir my heart?”
With a sweet tone I’ve never heard and a gentle expression I’ve never seen, he’s clearly trying to charm me.
But afraid I couldn’t escape the original plot, I handed him a request to break off the engagement…
“If you have any regrets, you should have done it before you took advantage of me.”
Wait, why is there suddenly a confinement plotline that wasn’t in the original story?!

114042.synopsis:
From the beginning, it was a paradoxical encounter.
“A clean body for someone in the mafia.”
She, the agent—
“I don’t like drawing on my body, so I haven’t.”
—and he, the mafia boss, met.
“But if you want it.”
His steps were elegant and dignified. Why was someone in the mafia even graceful?
“I could at least engrave your name.”
He picked up a pen with the unusually long space between his middle and index fingers. He pulled off the pen cap with his lips and spat it on the floor, then rolled up one sleeve.
A black line from the pen drew across his pale skin.
{Hye-young}
Hye-young. A name her Italian adoptive parents insisted she keep, saying the Korean name was beautiful.
“How is it? Do you think it’ll look pretty?”
Looking at his elegantly drawn handwriting, Hye-young replied.
“… What if I say it will?”
“If you say it’s pretty,”
A sinister light shimmered in his eyes.
“I’ll engrave it right now.”
Why was it that, at the mention of him engraving a tattoo on his arm, the space between her legs tightened?
“You… really…”
One thing was for sure—He really was a madman.

114554.synopsis:
Chi Qiong was the only surviving ancient divine phoenix in the heavens and earth, having slumbered for billions of years before being awakened by a mediocre spirit contract master named Yun Xiguang in modern times.
He discovered that the wings that once overshadowed the heavens had turned into tender little wings, and his once majestic figure that towered over ancient beasts had become a round, chubby, fluffy body that could be held in the palm of one’s hand—a mere fledgling.
Chi Qiong gazed sternly at the spirit contract master Yun Xiguang with his tiny, bean-like eyes:
“Human, become my spirit-servant; lend me thy aid to restore mine ancient power, and I shall grant thee ten thousand years of glory.”
However, when he opened his mouth, all that came out was: “Chirp, chirp, chirp!”
In order to show this ignorant human his might, Chi Qiong bestowed upon him a single phoenix feather.
Yun Xiguang picked up the downy feather that had fallen to the ground and sighed: “Sigh, the only spirit beast willing to respond to me is a little chick that sheds feathers. What else can I do? I’ll just have to dote on it.”
—
[Modern Spiritbond Master Shou X Ancient Divine Phoenix Chirping Gong] l

119418.synopsis:
s*um Gong (×) Pure Love (√), A Series of Misunderstandings Between Two Love-Struck Individuals
The s*um male Zerg prince who humiliated his empress, the Tianjia male Zerg consort who assassinated the emperor, the malicious dodder flower who pushed his boyfriend into a zombie horde… When they get bound by the [s*um Gong Transformation Livestream Room] , the plot, originally hurtling towards a tragic ending, gets rewritten into a happy ending in a strange way.

123002.synopsis:
My childhood friend complained I was too mouthy, not at all like a proper girl.
He told me to learn from the gentle campus belle.
But who would’ve thought the campus belle herself would be staring at my mouth, lost in thought.
“I heard you’re such a chatterbox you could get a mute to talk?”
She wanted me to go pester her autistic brother, offering a thousand yuan for every single word I could get out of him.
The campus belle was still too naive. A renegade like me has her own tricks.
I walked to the back of the classroom and gently tapped on the quiet boy’s desk.
“Aren’t you going to explain it to everyone? You know, about licking my feet while I was asleep last night.”
His eyes widened, and a crack appeared on his frozen face.
“I did not.”
I turned back confidently and flashed a brilliant smile at the campus belle.
“Pay up.”

123258.synopsis:
I transmigrated and became a fox spirit, accidentally possessing the body of a high school girl.
No big deal. Even though I was a man in my past life, as long as I can maintain my cute girl persona in this life, there’s still a chance to turn things around and reclaim my manly pride!
But as a hardcore shut-in, suddenly having to act like a bright and bubbly schoolgirl is seriously asking too much of this fox~
What’s worse, this beautiful girl is actually eyeing her childhood friend’s body! How the hell am I supposed to play that role?!
…
As Shen Yan looked at the sleeping girl, he fell into deep thought.
That fluffy tail and those ears…
So my childhood friend… is actually a fox spirit?

135546.synopsis:
Yin Sangyu is the youngest war god in the history of the empire, currently “retired due to injury” and idling at home.
He was unexpectedly bound by a system and learned that the world he inhabits is a romance novel titled His Majesty the Emperor’s Little Beta, in which he is a background figure, the protagonist’s white moonlight, never appearing in the story.
But now, he has been assigned a formidable task: to use love to redeem the novel’s great villain—Xiao Muyi.
In the novel, Xiao Muyi has a twisted personality, ruthless and vicious, sinister and difficult to deal with. Being targeted by him means sleeping with one eye open. Moreover, he harbors a severe aversion to alphas.
As an alpha, Yin Sangyu: This is simple. I just won’t be an alpha.
System: [?] 
*
[One bottle of disguise potion] + [One alpha with maxed-out attractiveness] 
Thus, a cold and regal omega sister, capable of being both salty and sweet, wealthy and powerful, with peerless beauty, was born out of nowhere.
The only flaw is that this regal omega sister could fight ten people at once and stands half a head taller than Xiao Muyi.
*
Yin Sangyu (scheming beautiful alpha, top) x Xiao Muyi (gloomy, sickly omega disguised as beta, bottom)

144762.synopsis:
After being rejected in love, Jae-gyeong vowed never to love anyone again. On the first day he reports to his new company and new team, he meets a man named Da-sol who has a face identical to the woman he once loved. It turns out he is Da-sol’s older brother.
How could fate play such a trick?
Jae-gyeong desperately tries to avoid Da-sol, but Da-sol already believes Jae-gyeong has a crush on him.
‘I am not in love with you. I liked your sister!’
Yet the more he gets to know Da-sol, the more Da-sol makes his fragile heart flutter. Is this feeling happening because of Da-sol’s face? Or is it… a new kind of love?
***
“Listen carefully, you pe*verted stalker. I hate men with dicks more than anything, and popping the balls of guys like that is my hobby. If you want to keep yours intact, you had better act right.”
“Y, yes…?”
Da-sol’s low voice was so frightening and cold, and the words felt so unfair that Jae-gyeong’s eyes filled with tears.
“And I will say this only once. I am not gay. I do not accept confessions.”
“Yes, I am not gay either… I will never confess… I will make sure you never have to worry…”
Jae-gyeong, tense like a soldier under inspection, responded hesitantly yet obediently. Da-sol glared at him with eyes sharp as a honed axe blade, then walked into the apartment first.
‘I just hope Da-sol does not hate me too much…’
Jae-gyeong thought that with a sad face. Yet it soon became clear that this was a hopeless wish.

150138.synopsis:
So Kihyun confesses his long-held unrequited love to his childhood friend Jo Yeon-oh, who despises relationships with betas.
What comes back is nothing but a cutting rebuke.
“Are you out of your f*cking mind, you crazy bastard… You forgot you’re a beta, didn’t you?”
Yeon-oh dry-heaves at Kihyun’s confession.
Kihyun wants to quietly put an end to his feelings, but Jo Yeon-oh can’t bring himself to let go of his friend.
“Fine. Let’s date, you selfish f*cking bastard.”
Jo Yeon-oh looks more wounded than anyone.
The confession tastes of salt. It is the beginning of a love already crusted with salt.
